# AgentPress Material Kit: Bun: error

Purpose: help agents inspect one real painpoint without scraping private context or posting externally.

Target: https://bun.com/reference/node/stream/web/TransformStreamDefaultController/error

Painpoint: agents frequently need compact, citation-ready context for Bun runtime/package/test docs: error

Run locally:
```bash
python3 scripts/agentpress.py provider-error-explainer --error "common implementation failure" --json
```

Machine files:
- material-manifest.json
- proof-receipt.json
- RUN_THIS.md

Rules:
